records.name: NCTE Recognised B.Ed Colleges
records.description: NCTE Recognised B.Ed Colleges are institutions approved by the National Council for Teacher Education to offer the two-year Bachelor of Education degree for aspiring school teachers.

records.name: IITs (Statistics Dept)
records.description: Select IIT departments and centres offer specialized postgraduate and doctoral programs in Statistics, combining rigorous mathematical training with applied data analysis and probabilistic modeling.

records.name: Coursera / edX MicroMasters
records.description: Online learning platforms offering MicroMasters and professional certificate programs from global universities, widely used by Indian learners for upskilling in technology, business, and data science.

records.name: IIM A/B/C (MBA Finance)
records.description: The flagship MBA programs at IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore, and Calcutta with a Finance specialization are among the most coveted postgraduate management qualifications in India and Asia.

records.name: SP Jain
records.description: S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai offers finance-focused MBA and PGDM programs recognized for strong placements in investment banking, consulting, and corporate finance.

records.name: ISB Hyderabad
records.description: Indian School of Business, Hyderabad is a globally ranked business school offering a one-year Post Graduate Programme in Management, known for its faculty, research, and corporate network.

records.name: XLRI
records.description: Xavier Labour Relations Institute, Jamshedpur offers finance and business management programs with a strong tradition of academic rigor, ethical grounding, and industry relevance.

records.name: NIMHANS Bangalore
records.description: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences, Bengaluru is India's apex centre for mental health education, research, and patient care, offering postgraduate and doctoral programs in psychiatry and neurosciences.

records.name: TISS Mumbai
records.description: Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai is a premier deemed university offering postgraduate programs in social work, human resources, public health, education, and media and cultural studies.

records.name: Delhi University
records.description: University of Delhi is one of India's largest and most prestigious central universities, known for its undergraduate colleges, postgraduate departments, and research centers across disciplines.
